CustomField.description: Lifecycle state of the LOI. THE MASTER SET IS THE UNION OF TWO RECORD-TYPE SETS AND NO SINGLE RECORD TYPE SEES ALL TEN. Acquisition_LOI exposes Draft, Prepare/Review, Sent, Counter, Completed (unchanged). Disposition_LOI exposes Received, Under Review, Countered by DPEG, Counter Received from Buyer, Executed. The two sets are FULLY DISJOINT, so unlike NDA__c.Status__c this field alone DOES identify the record type - which is what makes every stage-keyed flexipage rule self-limiting with no record-type criterion. Five values were APPENDED 2026-08-09 and ZERO were removed, so every existing LOI keeps a valid value and no picklist sweep is needed. Drives the LOI Lightning Path (LOI_Path_Acquisition / LOI_Path_Disposition) and RecordStageAdvanceService.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick the stage this LOI is in. The choices differ by record type: an acquisition LOI runs Draft, Prepare/Review, Sent, Counter, Completed; a disposition LOI runs Received, Under Review, Countered by DPEG, Counter Received from Buyer, Executed.
CustomField.label: Stage
